Title: Users' recordings of presentations using PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams may be missing some slides

User impact: Users' recordings of presentations using PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams may be missing some slides.

Current status: Our service health monitoring indicates that the impact previously communicated through TM1483625 is re-occurring. We're deploying a fix to rebalance the request traffic being routed to the portion of affected infrastructure so that we can bring the service back within our optimal performance threshold. 

Scope of impact: Any user located in the United States that is recording PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams presentations may be impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Monday, September 28, 2026, at 1:00 PM UTC

Root cause: A subset of networking service infrastructure that helps facilitate access to PowerPoint Live content has fallen below our manageable service performance thresholds, resulting in impact.

Next update by: Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at 11:30 PM UTC
